Hanno Ecotourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-canoe-seakayak/

Explore the rich natural beauty of Naguri Lake by paddling wooden sea kayaks crafted from local timber. This eco-tour is guided by staff from the certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop.

【Price】
Adults: ¥6,000 | Elementary school and younger: ¥4,000
(Includes guide, insurance, kayak rental, and food materials)

【Capacity】
2-person kayaks × 2 boats

【Guide】
Certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop staff

【What to Bring】
Drink, towel, change of clothes (you may get wet), clothes suitable for water, and sun protection (hat, sunglasses, etc.) as needed.

【More Information】
Certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop: https://naguri-canoe.co.jp/
